title: Inorganic nitrogen exchange through straits
query: Quantify the seasonal exchange of dissolved inorganic nitrogen between the South China Sea and adjacent seas using the supplied 2018–2022 historical CMOMS simulation. Compare transport through the Luzon, Mindoro–Balabac, Karimata and Taiwan gateways, identify their roles as net sources or sinks, and assess how those roles change through the seasonal cycle.
